messages:
maia: Quick RFC — small UX for the deploy bot to make pinning and release notes easier. idea: add template objects + CLI aliases so oncall can run presets.
jamal: SGTM. Is this for immediate pinned deploys or for preflight templates we reuse?
maia: Preflight templates mostly. Example commands:
```
/deploy template create --name=canary-night --pin=web@v2.3.1 --window="23:00-02:00" --notes="canary for new cache layer"
/deploy run --from-template=canary-night --dry-run
```
liam: +1. Could we also add an explicit rollback alias? e.g. `/deploy rollback --from-template=canary-night --fast=true` so it's one command in panic.
sophia: Safety checks we should enforce: validate pinned version exists, check change windows intersect, run `deployctl preflight --prometheus` and fail fast if alerts firing.
maia: Agreed. Plan: template schema stores pin, window, notes, required checks. CLI will run lint steps before creating / running. Also add `--notes-template` to autofill release notes.
release-bot: Note: added `template.create` webhook hook idea to the backlog (ticket #INF-4691)
jamal: Can we have an alias generator? `deploy template create --from=example-service` to scaffold.
liam: I'll take rollback alias + docs. will open PR with CLI arg parsing + YAML schema. assigning to @liam.
maia: Thanks — I'll draft the release note stub generator too. ping me for review. :thumbsup:
